name: Refrigeration Duty Characterization
anti_triggers: refrigeration duty already characterized with evidence
physical_basis: Refrigeration duty is the dominant electrical load in cold-chain assets. It is driven by product turnover, setpoint, ambient conditions, infiltration, and defrost strategy — not by floor area alone.
operational_basis: Refrigeration plant can be oversized, mis-staged, or running on degraded controls. Without duty characterization, retrofit logic targets the wrong variable.
financial_mechanism: Mis-characterizing refrigeration duty leads to wrong CAPEX prioritization (compressor swap vs. controls vs. envelope vs. defrost).
typical_false_assumption: Refrigerated kWh/sf benchmarks alone determine refrigeration efficiency.
hypothesis: Refrigeration duty must be decomposed (product pull-down vs. holding vs. defrost vs. infiltration) before any equipment replacement logic.
rival_hypotheses: refrigeration is sized correctly and operating well
envelope/infiltration dominates and refrigeration is responding correctly
defrost strategy is the primary degradation pathway
falsification_conditions: refrigeration duty already bounded with evidence
allowed_claim_language: Refrigeration duty is the structurally dominant load and must be decomposed before equipment-first logic.
financial_exposure_if_true: wrong CAPEX target without duty decomposition
escalation_conditions: field walk-through if documentary evidence insufficient
claim_permissions_impact: block refrigeration-CAPEX-first logic without duty decomposition
example_outputs: Refrigeration duty composition (pull-down vs holding vs defrost) is the deciding question.
tests: cold_chain bundle should activate this when compressor inventory is unresolved
